question: The number of gold medals won by India at the Tokyo olympics 2020 is______
solution:
The correct answer is __**one.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India won only **one gold medal **at the** Tokyo Olympics 2020.**
 
• The gold medal was won by **Neeraj Chopra** in the** men's javelin throw event.**
 
• India's total medal tally at the Tokyo Olympics was **seven,** including **one gold, two silver, and four bronze medals.**
 
• India's performance at the Tokyo Olympics was **commendable,** with several athletes achieving personal bests and breaking national records.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tokyo Olympics 2020** was an international multi-sport competition that took place in** Tokyo, Japan**, from **July 23, 2021, to August 8, 2021.**
 
• On **September 7, 2013,** in **Buenos Aires, Argentina,** during the **125th IOC Session,** Tokyo was chosen as the host city.
 
• **China** ranked second in both categories (38 and 89), trailing the **United States** in both total golds (39) and total medals (113).
 
• **Japan**, the host country,** finished third**, breaking the previous records for the most gold medals (27), and the total number of medals (58), ever won by a delegation at an Olympic Games.
 
• **Finishing fourth** overall with 64 medals and 22 golds was** Great Britain. **
